description: Turn any text into spoken audio right in your browser. Pick a voice, adjust speed and pitch, then speak, pause, resume or stop.

faqs.a: It uses the built-in speech synthesis of your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari). No audio files are created or uploaded.
The voice list comes from your device and browser. Different devices and browsers offer different voices and languages.
faqs.q: Why do I see different voices on different devices?

faqs.a: Some browsers need a moment to load voices. If the list is empty, wait a second and reload the page.
faqs.q: The voice list is empty. What should I do?

howto: Paste or type the text you want to hear.
Choose a voice from the dropdown.
Adjust the rate and pitch sliders.
Click Speak, and use Pause, Resume or Stop anytime.
title: Text to Speech
